question: To minimize the percentage error in the measurement of resistance using a Meter Bridge, where should the balance point preferably be located?

options.A: Near the zero end of the wire ($0 \text{ cm}$).
options.B: Near the $100 \text{ cm}$ mark of the wire.
options.C: Near the middle of the wire ($50 \text{ cm}$).
